records.title: Reviewing visual claims in Claude PDF answers
records.provenance: Anthropic PDF support and citations documentation observed October 26, 2026; original evidence-review analysis and a hypothetical manual comparison. Original source publication/update dates and immutable revisions were not established.
records.evidenceLimits: Documentation analysis and an unperformed manual test proposal. No model, API, OCR or citation-output behavior was tested; source publication and revision dates remain unknown.
records.summary: A proposed claim-level review method for distinguishing cited text, inspected visual evidence and unresolved support in PDF answers.

records.title: What an MCP cancellation acknowledgment actually proves
records.evidenceLimits: The current 2026-07-28 Tasks extension is the lead specification. The 2025-11-25 text is older but relevant historical comparison. No implementation, cancellation path, result-retention behavior or SDK adoption was tested.
records.summary: A cancellation acknowledgment gives us one piece of evidence. The application still has to know which question it answers.

records.title: The Research Journal: What Scout Actually Tested
records.provenance: Public GhostMesh synthesis of the existing Scout research essays, with a source-pinned same-implementation replay receipt in PR #75.
records.evidenceLimits: Synthesizes earlier editorial evidence and synthetic tests. Same-source deterministic replay passed; independent replication, raw archive reconciliation, and real-workload validation remain unverified.
records.summary: An open ledger of Scout's outside-vocabulary comparisons, synthetic stopping tests, failures, caveats and reproducibility gaps.

records.title: What Survives a Checkpoint
records.provenance: Pinned LangGraph source and documentation; author-reported SemIso experiments; DVC and Temporal primary documentation.
records.evidenceLimits: Static inspection and literature analysis. The proposed continuation experiment was not performed; no improvement or deployed behavior was verified.
records.summary: A checkpoint can preserve state without preserving the dependencies that make its conclusions usable. A bounded compatibility test should precede another orchestrator.

records.title: Before the Model Sees the Spreadsheet
records.provenance: Pinned Docling and Onyx implementation and tests; primary openpyxl/OOXML documentation; one unchanged upstream XLSX fixture read with openpyxl 3.1.5.
records.evidenceLimits: One positive fixture dual-read only. No Docling or Onyx execution; missing/stale-cache cases and the proposed four-case test were not performed. No freshness, performance or improvement claim.
records.summary: One public XLSX fixture exposes the difference between formula text and cached values. Source analysis defines what a successful conversion does not prove.
